content.en: Choose a Question Master (QM). QM announces a category, deals the same secret title to every artist except one X card, and chooses the first artist. QM does not draw; the X holder is the Fake Artist.
content.zh: 选 1 人做出题者（QM）。QM 公开类别，将同一个秘密题目发给除 1 人外的所有艺术家，并指定首位画家。QM 不画画；拿到 X 卡的人是伪艺术家。

content.en: Take turns clockwise. On your turn, add one continuous line, then pass the paper. Real Artists should leave a recognisable clue without giving the title away. Never show a card or say the title.
content.zh: 按顺时针轮流。你的回合只能画一条连续线，然后传纸。真艺术家要留下可辨认的线索，但不能泄露题目；不可展示卡片或直接说出题目。

alt.en: Artists add one continuous mark each to a shared drawing
alt.zh: 艺术家依次给共同画作添一条连续线

content.en: Repeat the same clockwise order. Each artist now adds their second and final continuous mark. When the paper returns to the last artist, every artist has drawn exactly two marks.
content.zh: 按同一顺时针顺序再进行一圈。每位艺术家画自己的第二、也是最后一条连续线。最后一人完成后，每位艺术家都恰好画过两笔。

content.en: After a brief look at the drawing, QM counts down and every artist—including the fake—points at one suspect. The fake is caught only if they are the sole highest-voted player. A tie means the fake escapes.
content.zh: 观察画面后，QM 倒数，所有艺术家（包括伪艺术家）同时指向 1 名嫌疑人。只有伪艺术家成为唯一最高票才算被抓；平票则伪艺术家逃脱。

alt.en: The vote determines whether the Fake Artist must guess the title
alt.zh: 投票结果决定伪艺术家是否必须猜题

content.en: The Fake Artist and QM score 2 points each. The fake may share a title guess while revealing the answer, but gains no extra points. Rotate QM left and begin a new round.
content.zh: 伪艺术家与 QM 各得 2 分。揭晓答案时，伪艺术家可以说出自己的猜测，但不会额外得分。QM 向左轮换，开始新一轮。

content.en: Reveal the X card. The Fake Artist gets exactly one guess at the title: a correct guess gives the Fake Artist and QM 2 points each; a wrong guess gives every Real Artist 1 point. Rotate QM left for the next round.
content.zh: 翻开 X 卡。伪艺术家只能猜 1 次题目：猜对时伪艺术家与 QM 各得 2 分；猜错时每位真艺术家各得 1 分。QM 向左轮换，进入下一轮。
